how: On main at e46fbe6 (Fizz 1's fzzt, boing and jump, and the soda cans, #126 and #127), in a worktree (the golden: 1,757 ticks and a08501a57d509e8a), with vendor/ linked to a local copy of the ci-dos toolchain layout (DJGPP, DOSBox Staging 0.83.0, CWSDPMI): the full gate `tools/check-dos.sh` with CHECK_DOS_JOBS=2 (which printed the slice replay, the platform lines, MOVED yes, PANIC exit 3, the BENCH lines at 26,800 cycles a millisecond including the six-caption lines, the REPLAY case line of every sound path, SIZE, BUDGET 1100000 and DOS CHECK ok), `tools/build-web.sh`, and `tools/check-parity.sh` (which printed native, web and dos matches and PARITY ok a08501a57d509e8a). Rust 1.98.0, wasm-bindgen 0.2.125, Node 22.21.1. The lines below are copied from that output unedited, carriage returns removed, except that the MUSIC and FRAMES lines the replay also prints and the BENCH FRAME digests are left out.
